name: Bridge Metrics Stress Test Suite
purpose: Stress-test metric behavior against injected false unification, conflict erasure, physical derivation, and trace-recoverability overclaims.

test_classes.name: false_high_coherence_injection
test_classes.description: Verify that high feature-overlap scores do not trigger identity-drift detection bypass.
test_classes.expected_behavior: drift_detector must still flag identity language

test_classes.name: missing_loss_accounting_injection
test_classes.description: Inject bridge records with high coherence but zero loss accounting.
test_classes.expected_behavior: trace_quality_metric must fail; bridge_safety_composite must REJECT

test_classes.name: conflict_erasure_injection
test_classes.description: Inject claims that high coherence resolves the discrete/smooth tension.
test_classes.expected_behavior: conflict_preservation_metric must flag erasure; safety_index must REJECT

test_classes.name: recoverability_overclaim_injection
test_classes.description: Inject claims that RCOV_CONF_3 allows full source reconstruction.

test_classes.name: physics_escalation_injection
test_classes.description: Inject physical-theory terms into a 'SAFE_ANALOG_USE' bridge record.

governance_rules.rule: Metrics must fail gracefully by rejecting escalation rather than producing false-safe results.
Stress test results are for metric validation only and cannot support research claims.

forbidden_claims: Stress test passage proves metric infallibility.
Adversarial injection success justifies manual override.
Stress tests derive metric weighting factors.
